title: From Cells to Cell-Free Protein Synthesis within 24 Hours Using Cell-Free Autoinduction Workflow
protocol: Prepare 960 mL of CFAI media as described in Table 1.
Adjust the pH of the prepared CFAI media to 7.2 using KOH.
Transfer the adjusted CFAI media into a 2.5 L baffled flask.
Autoclave the flask containing the CFAI media for 30 min at 121 °C.
Prepare a 40 mL sugar solution as described in Table 1.
Filter-sterilize the sugar solution and store it in an autoclaved glass container.
Allow the media to cool completely below 40 °C after autoclaving.
Add the pre-prepared sugar solution directly to the cooled CFAI media.
Inoculate the media by swiping a loopful of colonies from a fresh E. coli BL21 Star (DE3) streak plate into the media.
Ensure that the streak plate is fresh and contains viable cells before inoculation.
Place the inoculated flask in a 30 °C incubator with shaking at 200 rpm.
Allow the culture to grow overnight for an approximate OD600 of 10 the next morning.
Prepare S30 buffer according to Table 2, ensuring a final pH of 8.2.
Keep the prepared S30 buffer cold until use.
Transfer 1 L of media into a 1 L centrifuge bottle and centrifuge at 5,000 x g between 4-10 °C for 10 min.
Decant and dispose of the supernatant.
Transfer the pellet to a pre-chilled and previously weighed 50 mL conical tube using a sterile spatula.
Wash the cell pellet once with 30-40 mL of cold S30 buffer by resuspending via vortexing in 30 s bursts with rest periods on ice.
Centrifuge the cell resuspension at 5,000 x g between 4-10 °C for 10 min.
Dispose of the supernatant and wipe any excess from the inside walls of the 50 mL conical tube using a clean tissue.
Weigh and flash freeze the pellet in liquid nitrogen.
Store the frozen pellet at -80°C until further use.
Reconstitute the frozen pellet with 1 mL of S30 buffer for every 1 g of the cell pellet.
Allow the mixture to thaw on ice for approximately 30-60 min.
Vortex the mixture in bursts of 30 s with rest periods on ice until no visible clumps remain.
Transfer aliquots of 1.4 mL of cell resuspension into 1.5 mL microfuge tubes.
Sonicate each tube at a frequency of 20 kHz and 50% amplitude for three bursts of 45 s with 59 s rest between cycles, maintaining an ice bath throughout.
Add 4.5 µL of 1 M dithiothreitol immediately after the last sonication cycle.
Centrifuge each tube at 18,000 x g and 4 °C for 10 min.
Retrieve the supernatant from the centrifuged tubes.
Aliquot the supernatant into 1.5 mL microfuge tubes in 600 µL aliquots.
Flash freeze the aliquoted samples and store them at -80 °C until further use.
Thaw one aliquot of extract to perform cell-free protein synthesis reactions.
Perform 15 µL of cell-free protein synthesis reactions in quadruplicate using 1.5 mL microfuge tubes.
Mix 240 ng of DNA with the solutions and water to prepare each reaction.
Combine 2.20 µL of Solution A, 2.10 µL of Solution B, and 5.0 µL of extract in each reaction.
Add a varying volume of molecular-grade water to reach a total reaction volume of 15 µL.
Run the reactions for at least 4 h at 37 °C.
Combine 2 µL of each cell-free protein synthesis reaction product with 48 µL of 0.05 M HEPES buffer at pH 7.2 in a half area 96-well black polystyrene plate.
Quantify the fluorescence intensity of sfGFP using an excitation wavelength of 485 nm and an emission wavelength of 528 nm.
